bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
c=deploy-gaybbs-1
new=$(docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:applicant-live-48134d4 --format '{{.Id}}')
live=$(docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.Image}}')
status=$(docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.State.Status}}')
restarts=$(docker inspect "$c" --format '{{.RestartCount}}')
test "$live" = "$new" || exit 71
test "$status" = running || exit 72
test "$restarts" = 0 || exit 73
docker logs --since 5m "$c" 2>&1 | grep -q GAYBBS_BOT_READY || exit 74
docker exec "$c" sh -c "grep -q '応募者へDM' /app/gaybbs.mjs" || exit 75
docker inspect "$c" --format '{{range .Config.Env}}{{println .}}{{end}}' | grep -qx 'GAYBBS_NOTIFICATION_DELIVERY_ENABLED=enabled' || exit 76
echo APPLICANT_DM_INDEPENDENT_RUNTIME_PASS
echo IMAGE=applicant-live-48134d4
echo STATE="$status"
echo RESTART_COUNT="$restarts"
echo NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED=YES
